notes: Logo is the uncropped original of the header logo (the site header serves a cropped copy); it is a small file, about 6 KB. No heroImage given: the facts file uses the home page banner photo, and the drone shots in the gallery (DJI_0013, DJI_0032) are the alternatives to compare. Most trip pages carry one photo each, so trip lists are short and the six trips with no photo (Marine Field Study and the five menu-only Rezdy trips) are empty. Photo credit doubt: the site footer reads 'Built by Ecotreasures 2025 - Images@DNSW', which may mean some photos belong to Destination NSW. The files named 220606_NECI_Eco-Treasures_* (home story photo, founder photo, corporate wellness list thumbnail, favicon) look like one professional shoot and were left out; a person should confirm which of the remaining photos the operator may reuse, in particular the banner and the numbered 1001xxx photos. Also left out: the Advanced Ecotourism certification badge, the Cabbage Tree Bay habitat map (a diagram from a conservation report), icons and size-suffixed thumbnails, and the Duke of Ed, kids party and incursion photos from the gallery (they are on those trips only; the kids party photo probably shows children). Page images that loaded from the demo subdomain (demo.ecotreasures.com.au) were mapped to the live image host, and the original of GOPR7913 was used instead of its 1024 pixel copy. Image URLs were checked with HEAD requests only, nothing downloaded. Videos: the site links its YouTube channel (ECOTREASURES TV) but embeds none on its pages; the six listed came from the channel's public feed, chosen as the snorkel tour videos, and I have not watched them, so a person should check for guests on screen. Left out: an off-topic surf check video, a post-tour review video and the older founder vlogs. The Tour Photos page links many guest GoPro share videos (gopro.com); these are guests' own footage and were not used. No Facebook or Instagram was opened, no Rezdy or FareHarbor page was opened, and no bot check or captcha was met on the site.
